version.changelog:
furry-art-skill v1.5.0

- Added new `--style` option to choose between anime, cinematic, and realistic art styles (default: anime).
- Updated API description to reflect use of the "Neta talesofai API".
- Streamlined documentation and removed outdated token instructions.

llm.summary: The skill's behavior matches a furry-image generator and only needs a single API token, but registry metadata and SKILL.md contain inconsistencies (missing required env in registry, wrong tool hint), and the source/homepage is unknown — review before installing.

dimensions.detail: The code implements an image-generation client that posts prompts to https://api.talesofai.cn and polls for a result — this matches the skill's stated purpose. However the registry metadata claims no required env vars while package.json and the script require a NETA_TOKEN; that mismatch is an incoherence in the metadata.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to running the included Node script which reads CLI args (prompt, size, token, ref) and communicates only with the talesofai API. The script does not access arbitrary local files, system config, or additional environment variables beyond the token.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec that downloads code from an external URL; the skill is provided as code files (node script + package.json). No extract/download steps are present in the registry metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only required secret is an API token (NETA_TOKEN), which is proportionate to an API-backed image generator. The incoherence is that the registry metadata lists 'Required env vars: none' while package.json declares NETA_TOKEN as required and the script enforces a --token or env token.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request elevated or persistent privileges (always: false). It does not modify other skills or system settings and only runs when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: send your prompt to the talesofai API and return an image URL. Before installing, double-check the following: (1) the registry metadata is inaccurate about required environment variables — the script requires a NETA_TOKEN (or --token) so you will be sending that token to api.talesofai.cn; (2) the SKILL.md header mentions 'tools: Bash' but the code is Node — minor but shows sloppy packaging; (3) the source/homepage is unknown, so verify the publisher or review the code yourself if you will supply a real API token. If you decide to proceed, consider using a token with limited scope or rate limits and test with non-sensitive prompts first.
